subject: science
passage: Glass frogs live in the rainforests of Central and South America. Many species have see-through skin on their ______ a feature that lets an observer watch the frog's heart beating. Researchers have also found that sleeping glass frogs hide most of their red blood cells in their livers, which makes the frogs even harder to spot.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "Many species have see-through skin on their bellies" is a complete independent clause. "A feature that lets an observer watch the frog's heart beating" is a noun phrase that adds extra information about that skin, so it is set off with a comma.
explanation.A: Incorrect. A semicolon must be followed by an independent clause, but "a feature that lets an observer watch the frog's heart beating" has no main verb.
explanation.B: Incorrect. A period would leave "A feature that lets an observer watch the frog's heart beating" as a sentence fragment.
explanation.C: Correct. A comma correctly sets off the extra information at the end of the sentence.
explanation.D: Incorrect. Without a comma, the extra information runs straight into "bellies," and the sentence can't be read clearly.
